speaker: Mirella
en: (Coldly) Eloísa, you can leave now. (Turns around and leaves)

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （嘀咕）不对，给Damián下药了。一会儿他要是药性发作，对总裁做什么事怎么办？
en: (muttering) Oh, no. I drugged Damián! What if it kicks in and he tries something with the CEO?

speaker: Eloísa
cn: 总裁！人交给你了，出了什么事都与我无关啊！（松了口气）
en: Ms. Elorza! Damián’s all yours now. Whatever happens next has nothing to do with me! (relieved)

speaker: Isadora
en: (whispering) We'll go to your place later.

speaker: Isadora
cn: （皱眉）他现在还不知道我的身份，去我家不方便。你先出去住酒店，费用我报销。
en: (frowning) He still doesn’t know who I really am, so I can’t take him back to my place. You stay at a hotel for now. I’ll cover the cost.

speaker: Isadora
cn: （震惊）你怎么这么烫？Damián?（羞恼）你前女友究竟给你吃了什么东西？
en: (Shocked) Gosh you're boiling, Damián! (Blushing and annoyed) What on earth did your ex-girlfriend give you?

speaker: Isadora
cn: （倒吸一口凉气）没想到你的身材这么有料。
en: (Gasps in surprise) Wow... I didn’t know you were hiding a body like that.

speaker: Damián
en: (gasping) Isadora, give it to me—I want you now!

speaker: Isadora
en: (frowning, with a cheerful expression) Ouch, Damián...

speaker: Isadora
cn: （咬Damián耳朵，享受）你好棒啊，我还要……
en: (Bites Damián's ear, enjoying it) You're amazing! Give me more...

speaker: Damián
cn: （懵）我昨晚都干了什么啊？（震惊捂脸）戒指给的那瓶酒竟然是真的！
en: (confused) What on earth did I do last night? (shocked, covering his face) The bottle of wine that Ring gave me—was legit!
